title: Native heart structural and localizing properties
statement: For a finite field k₀, a prime l distinct from its characteristic, and any k₀-scheme T, HeartProperties k₀ l T holds, in the exact sense of [def-sf-native-weil-induction-comparison-data]: the two hearts are Grothendieck, forgetting is exact, derived forgetting is triangulated and conservative and preserves small coproducts, heart forgetting preserves K-injectives, Frobenius preserves bounded constructibles and their localizing hull, and the integer free cofan is colimiting.

proof.text: Apply the existing native Grothendieck instances, the fixed-pair and free-derived-resolution properties, constructible inverse image under Frobenius, and minimality of localizing closure. Localize the termwise free coproduct cocone. The localized free adjunction unit is its zeroth leg, and the structure recurrence identifies all integer legs with inclusion. This gives every clause of HeartProperties.
